title: ADR 020: Populi mesh scaling — default transport posture
summary: Keeps HTTP Populi as the default coordination SSOT, with optional additive layers like gossip and QUIC evaluated only after GPU truth and lease correctness are established.
notes: Amended 2026-09-04 to record supersession by ADR-047. Status changed from Accepted to Superseded; decision no longer locked and authoritative precedence transfers to ADR-047.
